source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The actual requester asks for independently randomized complex concept tests, reference-informed prompts, generation and pixel assessment. Arm C independently chooses a festival-plaza basketball rebound in circa-2000 Y2K pop-sport street fashion from the coordinator-supplied random domain; the specific scene, era realization and wardrobe are agent-owned creative choices rather than requester definitions.
subject: An unmistakably adult woman with visible appearance guidance from the supplied reference, wearing circa-2000 pop-sport street fashion; one adult stall attendant supports the wind-disturbance event.
setting: An outdoor civic fountain plaza beside temporary festival stalls, with a marked pop-up basketball court, portable hoop and parked speaker cart.
event: The main subject has secured a basketball rebound and lands with the ball in both hands, while a gust lifts music flyers beside a speaker cart and an adult attendant reaches toward them.
visual_priorities: The cropped sporty tee, low-rise roomy track-pant silhouette and chunky sneaker ensemble stay visibly distinct.
The rebound is legible through both hands on the ball, bent elbows, flexed knees and visible ground contact.
A wind-driven flyer spill beside consumer music equipment adds a concurrent public-festival event.
Reference-guided visible face and dark bob remain readable in a full-body outdoor photograph.
baseline_prompt_en: An unmistakably adult woman is photographed in Y2K pop-sport street fashion around 2000 at a civic fountain plaza beside temporary festival stalls. In a pickup game on a marked pop-up court, she has just secured a basketball rebound beneath a portable hoop. Both hands clasp opposite sides of the ball at chest height; her elbows bend naturally in front of her torso. Her feet land shoulder-width apart on the dry paving, with both knees flexed and the ball held within her own arm span. She wears a cropped baby tee with a white body and sky-blue raglan sleeves, low-rise roomy nylon track pants in cobalt with white side piping, and chunky platform sneakers. A thin silver hip chain hangs against the waistband, and slim tinted wraparound sunglasses sit on top of her dark chin-length bob with separated fringe. Her visible appearance follows the reference image's dark eyes, softly defined eyelids, light skin and softly colored lips. A gust has lifted several paper music flyers from an open crate on a parked portable speaker cart beside the court; the cart also holds a silver portable CD player with its transparent disc lid visible. An adult stall attendant reaches toward the floating flyers while the player glances across the ball toward this disturbance. Fountain jets and fabric stall canopies establish the open public space behind them. Use a low three-quarter full-body photograph from just beyond the main path, showing her face, waistband, both hands, the ball and both sneakers clearly. Clear late-afternoon sunshine gives the nylon folds crisp highlights, and wind lifts the tee hem and loose fringe while the court, hoop, cart and airborne paper remain spatially legible.
